name: Your Swimsuit Jumped Over Its Own Weathercock, You Liar!
source:
A (questionably) ero visual novel whose text is entirely driven by Markov chains, with the exception of a few strategically-placed ellipses. Story choices are also randomized, as is their effect on "winning".

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=21650]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一部（有疑问的）色情视觉小说，其文本完全由马尔可夫链驱动，除了一些策略性放置的省略号之外。故事选择也是随机的，它们对“获胜”的影响也是随机的。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=21650]引理软论坛[/url]]
